title: Rassimov's Secret/Quotes
summary:
"What do you think it means to be a leader in an army of chaos?"
- Zhalia Moon to Harrison Fears

"The Blood Spirals say they follow chaos, but they really just follow Rassimov."
- Den Fears to the team

"To be a leader, might is not enough."
- Rassimov to Harrison Fears

"The bond between Seeker and Titan is very special."
- Sophie Casterwill to Lok Lambert

"Why are you knocking on King Tut's door, Rassimov? Selling girl scout cookies again?"
- Dante Vale to Rassimov

"We've got to help them, that thing is... unnatural."
-Sophie Casterwill to Den Fears on helping the rest of the team defeat Legion

"It's not damaged at all. If we can't stop it..." (Lok Lambert on Legion) 

"If I can't stop it, I'll stop its master." (Dante Vale)

"This old Titan still has a few tricks."
- Cherit

"Looks like Legion is just another pretty face." (Dante Vale) 

"You haven't seen anything yet." (Rassimov)

"The bigger they are, the more I wanna knock them down."
- Den Fears on Legion

"Goodbye, old friend."
- Dante Vale after Solwing's amulet disappeared
